nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: Despeje, organize e relaxe! Water Sort traz a jogabilidade clássica para a VR com visuais 3D incríveis. Por que você vai amar: experiência ASMR, controles intuitivos e centenas de níveis de lógica.
nodes.short_description: O quebra-cabeça relaxante definitivo! Organize líquidos vibrantes nos tubos corretos com sons suaves e física VR fluida.

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: Toarnă, sortează și relaxează-te! Water Sort aduce jocul clasic în VR cu efecte vizuale 3D superbe. De ce îți va plăcea: experiență ASMR, controale intuitive și sute de provocări pentru creier.
nodes.short_description: Puzzle-ul relaxant suprem! Organizează lichide colorate în eprubetele corecte cu sunete liniștitoare și fizică VR fluidă.

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: Roztřiďte barvy a odpočiňte si! Water Sort přináší klasickou hratelnost do VR s plynulým ovládáním a stovkami úrovní. Procvičte svůj mozek bez stresu a časovačů.
nodes.short_description: Dokonalá relaxační hádanka! Přelijte barevné tekutiny do správných zkumavek v pohlcujícím 3D prostředí s uklidňujícími ASMR zvuky.

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: 倾倒、分类、放松！Water Sort 将经典的分类玩法通过精美的3D视觉效果呈现。理由：ASMR体验、直观的控制、以及数百个逻辑挑战等级，助您在无压力环境下锻炼大脑。
nodes.short_description: 极致放松的益智游戏！在拥有舒缓音效和流畅VR物理效果的3D体验中，将鲜艳的液体分类到正确的试管中。

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: Ρίξτε, ταξινομήστε και χαλαρώστε! Το Water Sort ζωντανεύει το κλασικό παιχνίδι με όμορφα τρισδιάστατα γραφικά. Χαρακτηριστικά: εμπειρία ASMR, διαισθητικά χειριστήρια και εκατοντάδες επίπεδα λογικής.
nodes.short_description: Το απόλυτο χαλαρωτικό παζλ! Ταξινομήστε πολύχρωμα υγρά στους σωστούς σωλήνες με καταπραϋντικούς ήχους ASMR και ομαλή φυσική VR.

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: 傾倒、分類、放鬆！Water Sort 將經典的分類玩法透過精美的 3D 視覺效果呈現。特色：ASMR 體驗、直覺的控制，以及數百個邏輯挑戰關卡。準備好邁向勝利了嗎？
nodes.short_description: 極致放鬆的益智遊戲！在具有舒緩音效和流暢 VR 物理效果的 3D 體驗中，將鮮豔的液體分類到正確的試管中。

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: ¡Vierte, clasifica y relájate! Water Sort le da vida al juego clásico con hermosos visuales 3D. Por qué te encantará: experiencia ASMR, controles intuitivos y cientos de desafíos mentales.
nodes.short_description: ¡El rompecabezas relax definitivo! Organiza líquidos vibrantes en los tubos correctos con sonidos relajantes y física VR fluida.

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: 따르고, 분류하고, 긴장을 푸세요! Water Sort는 클래식한 퍼즐을 아름다운 3D 비주얼로 구현했습니다. 추천 이유: ASMR 경험, 직관적인 조작, 그리고 수백 개의 두뇌 자극 레벨.
nodes.short_description: 궁극의 휴식 퍼즐! 부드러운 VR 물리 효과와 차분한 소리를 들으며 화려한 액체를 올바른 튜브에 정리하세요.

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: Giet, sorteer en kom tot rust! Water Sort brengt klassieke gameplay tot leven met prachtige 3D-beelden. Waarom je het geweldig zult vinden: ASMR-ervaring, intuïtieve besturing en honderden levels.
nodes.short_description: De ultieme ontspannende puzzel! Organiseer levendige vloeistoffen in de juiste buizen met rustgevende geluiden en vloeiende VR-fysica.

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: Hæld, sortér og slap af i VR! Water Sort tager det klassiske puslespil og gør det levende med 3D-grafik. Funktioner: ASMR-lyd, intuitive kontroller og hjernestimulerende udfordringer.
nodes.short_description: Den ultimative afslappende gåde! Organiser farverige væsker i de rigtige rør med beroligende lyde og glat VR-fysik.

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: Doldur, Sırala ve Rahatla! Water Sort klasik oynanışı harika 3D görsellerle VR'a taşıyor. Neden seveceksiniz: ASMR deneyimi, sezgisel kontroller ve yüzlerce zeka geliştirici seviye.

nodes.long_description: Kaada, lajittele ja rentoudu! Water Sort tuo klassisen pelattavuuden VR-maailmaan upeilla 3D-grafiikoilla. Nauti ASMR-äänistä ja testaa logiikkaasi sadoilla tasoilla.

nodes.long_description: Наливайте, сортируйте и отдыхайте! Water Sort оживляет классический геймплей в 3D. Почему вам понравится: ASMR-эффекты, интуитивное управление и сотни уровней для тренировки мозга.

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: Rót, sắp xếp và thư giãn! Water Sort mang lối chơi cổ điển vào không gian 3D sống động. Tại sao bạn sẽ thích: trải nghiệm ASMR, điều khiển trực quan và hàng trăm cấp độ thử thách logic.
nodes.short_description: Câu đố thư giãn đỉnh cao! Sắp xếp các chất lỏng màu sắc vào đúng ống nghiệm với âm thanh êm dịu và vật lý VR mượt mà.

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: Gießen, sortieren und entspannen! Water Sort bringt klassisches Gameplay in die VR. Genießen Sie die ASMR-Atmosphäre, intuitive Steuerung und hunderte von logischen Herausforderungen.
nodes.short_description: Das ultimative Entspannungsrätsel! Sortieren Sie farbige Flüssigkeiten in die richtigen Röhren mit beruhigenden Klängen und flüssiger VR-Physik.

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description: Häll, sortera och koppla av! Water Sort tar det klassiska spelet till VR med vacker 3D-grafik. Varför du kommer att älska det: ASMR-upplevelse, intuitiva kontroller och hundratals nivåer.
nodes.short_description: Det ultimata avkopplande pusslet! Organisera färgglada vätskor i rätt rör med lugnande ljud och smidig VR-fysik.

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description:
Pour, Sort, and Unwind in a Stunning VR Experience!

Dive into the most satisfying puzzle game on Meta Horizon. Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle takes the classic liquid-sorting gameplay and brings it to life with beautiful 3D visuals and immersive VR controls. Your goal is simple but addictive: sort the colored water in the tubes until each tube contains only one color.

Why You Will Love It:

Satisfying ASMR Experience: Enjoy the soothing sounds of water pouring and bubbling as you solve each level. It’s designed to be the ultimate stress-relief game.

Intuitive VR Controls: Use your controllers to grab, tilt, and pour water from one tube to another with natural and fluid motions.

Brain-Boosting Challenges: With hundreds of levels ranging from easy to expert, you’ll constantly find new ways to test your logic and strategy.

Vibrant 3D Graphics: Play in a clean, high-contrast environment where the colorful liquids pop against a sleek background.

Play at Your Own Pace: No timers and no pressure. If you get stuck, you can always restart or undo your last move.

Whether you're looking for a quick brain-teaser or a long, relaxing session, this game offers a refreshing twist on the sorting genre. Get ready to pour your way to victory!
nodes.short_description: The ultimate relaxing puzzle! Immerse yourself in Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle, a satisfying 3D experience where you organize vibrant liquids into their correct tubes. With soothing sounds and smooth VR physics, it’s the perfect way to sharpen your mind and destress. Can you solve the pour and match every color?

nodes.display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
nodes.long_description:
Pour, Sort, and Unwind in a Stunning VR Experience!

Dive into the most satisfying puzzle game on Meta Horizon. Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle takes the classic liquid-sorting gameplay and brings it to life with beautiful 3D visuals and immersive VR controls. Your goal is simple but addictive: sort the colored water in the tubes until each tube contains only one color.

Why You Will Love It:

Satisfying ASMR Experience: Enjoy the soothing sounds of water pouring and bubbling as you solve each level. It’s designed to be the ultimate stress-relief game.

Intuitive VR Controls: Use your controllers to grab, tilt, and pour water from one tube to another with natural and fluid motions.

Brain-Boosting Challenges: With hundreds of levels ranging from easy to expert, you’ll constantly find new ways to test your logic and strategy.

Vibrant 3D Graphics: Play in a clean, high-contrast environment where the colorful liquids pop against a sleek background.

Play at Your Own Pace: No timers and no pressure. If you get stuck, you can always restart or undo your last move.

Whether you're looking for a quick brain-teaser or a long, relaxing session, this game offers a refreshing twist on the sorting genre. Get ready to pour your way to victory!
nodes.short_description: The ultimate relaxing puzzle! Immerse yourself in Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle, a satisfying 3D experience where you organize vibrant liquids into their correct tubes. With soothing sounds and smooth VR physics, it’s the perfect way to sharpen your mind and destress. Can you solve the pour and match every color?
